attributes.name: ypy-prefetch
attributes.description: Asks for the page a link opens before the click, and uses the response for the click. A bare attribute means `hover`. Only a link YPY navigates is prefetched, with GET, on the page's own origin and never with form data. The nearest one above the link decides; `false` turns it off for a link or a region.

values.name: hover
values.description: After the pointer rests on the link or the link gets keyboard focus, or at once on touch.

values.name: visible
values.description: When the link comes into view.

values.name: false
values.description: Never, for this link or region.

attributes.name: ypy-once
attributes.description: On a `<script>` in swapped content: it runs only once per page. When a later response brings it again it is taken out before the swap. The script is told apart by the value of the attribute when it has one, else by its `src`, else by its text. A script that came with the page counts as already run.

config.name: nav
config.description: Settings of global boost and prefetch.

config.name: nav.boost
config.description: Navigate every link and form of the page with a request and a swap, with no attribute. Off when `nonce` is set. A region turns it off with `ypy-boost="false"`.

config.name: nav.prefetch
config.description: When a link the page navigates is requested ahead of the click.

config.name: nav.prefetchDelay
config.description: Milliseconds of hover, or of keyboard focus, before the prefetch starts.

config.name: nav.prefetchTtl
config.description: Milliseconds an unused prefetched response is kept.

config.name: nav.prefetchMax
config.description: Prefetched responses alive at once; the oldest is dropped.

config.name: nav.prefetchParallel
config.description: Prefetches in flight at once for the visibility mode.

config.name: nav.current
config.description: Mark the link to the current page with `aria-current="page"` and the class `ypy-current`, and renew the mark on every navigation. Set to `false` to turn it off.

config.name: nav.settle
config.description: Milliseconds a navigation (a boosted request, or one that pushes a history entry) waits for the requests the form being edited still has in flight, after the field in focus was blurred so its `change` ran. `0` turns the blur and the wait off.

config.name: nav.confirmLeave
config.description: Show the browser's own leave-this-page dialog (`beforeunload`) while a form has changes no request has saved. A control is changed from its first `input` event until a request from it, or from its form, ends with a 2xx other than a GET, or the form is reset. A navigation that only swaps the page does not unload it, so the browser shows nothing then.

config.name: nav.root
config.description: CSS selector of the root of the app. A boosted response that is a whole page (it has a doctype, `html` or `body`) and does not contain it is not swapped in: its URL is loaded as a plain page. Without it, the element with `ypy-history-elt` of the current page is the root, and a page that has none checks nothing. A response that ended on another origin is always loaded in full.

headers.name: YPY-Purpose
headers.description: Sent with every prefetch, with `Purpose: prefetch` and `Sec-Purpose: prefetch`. A script cannot set `Sec-Purpose` (the browser drops it), so read `Purpose` or this header to tell a prefetch from a visit.

classes.name: ypy-current
classes.description: Added, with `aria-current="page"`, to a link that points to the URL of the page (same path and query, no fragment); renewed on every navigation.
